ref: ADR-0004 as amended for F-17 (observed #31 d3): a source queue whose context element never occurs in the message is one empty context; removeContexts gives one context holding the values of all contexts
note: An empty input: <Orders/> has no Order and no Line, so the Sku queue is one empty context (F-17). removeContexts gives one context and it holds no value, so the root's one slot creates no All and the root is written empty.
